task.description:
Implement the remaining two API-03 endpoints in src/api/routes/instances.zig:
1. GET /instances/:id — returns instance state (status, current_tasks, variables, started_at, completed_at if terminal). HTTP 404 if not found. Any authenticated role.
2. GET /instances — lists instances, paginated by cursor (API-06), filterable by status and definition_id query params. Any authenticated role.

Read the design artefact at src/design/api-03-instance-management.md for the complete struct definitions, pagination strategy, SQL query sketches, and error taxonomy.

The existing POST /instances (handleCreate) and POST /instances/:id/cancel (handleCancel) in src/api/routes/instances.zig must not be modified — only ADD the two new handler functions.

After implementing, wire the new handlers into src/main.zig following the existing pattern for the other instance routes.

Then run:
  zig build
  zig build test
Both must exit 0 before completing the handoff.
acceptance_criteria: GET /instances/:id returns 200 with instance state or 404 if not found
GET /instances returns 200 with paginated list and cursor

result.summary: Implemented API-03 GET endpoints: added getById() and listInstances() methods to InstanceStore (src/engine/instance.zig), and handleGetById() and handleList() handlers to src/api/routes/instances.zig. Pagination uses cursor format: base64url(started_at_us:instance_id_hex:cursor_created_at_us) with 24h expiry check. All SQL values bound as positional parameters; no SQL string interpolation of user input. zig build and zig build test both exit 0.
